proposals.evidence: Turner gives eastern bihān/biyāna and Gujarati vahāṇũ/vāṇũ dawn, including morning adverbials. The survey tomorrow responses preserve this regional dawn/next-morning family. Turner also allows derivation via Middle Indo-Aryan vibhāyana brightening; this family placement leaves that internal formation alternative open and does not silently claim a unique reconstructed intermediate.
